# RyxerMart

> Modern, ultra-fast, mobile-first websites and custom e-commerce stores engineered for Indian businesses and entrepreneurs.

## Overview
RyxerMart is an Indian web development agency based in Jalandhar, Punjab, delivering high-converting, SEO-optimized business websites and online stores starting at ₹3,499. Every package includes 1 year free high-speed SSD cloud hosting, free SSL security certificates, mobile responsiveness, and direct WhatsApp customer ordering workflows.

## Website & Packages
- [Home](https://www.ryxer.site): Agency showcase, packages overview, and live WhatsApp consultation.
- [Services Catalog](https://www.ryxer.site/services): Full catalog of fixed-price website packages and digital solutions.
- [Starter Website Package](https://www.ryxer.site/services/starter-website): ₹3,499. 5–10 pages, mobile-first design, WhatsApp ordering, free 1-year hosting & SSL.
- [Royal Website Package](https://www.ryxer.site/services/royal-website): ₹5,499. 10–15 pages, custom admin panel, premium animations, SEO setup, lead capture.
- [Ecommerce Starter Package](https://www.ryxer.site/services/ecommerce-starter): ₹9,999. Full online store, product catalog, cart, WhatsApp & online checkout, order notifications.
- [Ecommerce Premium Package](https://www.ryxer.site/services/ecommerce-premium): ₹14,999. Enterprise store, unlimited inventory, coupon engine, priority support SLA.
- [How Ordering Works](https://www.ryxer.site/#how-it-works): 3–5 day delivery cycle with direct developer contact.
- [FAQ](https://www.ryxer.site/faq): Answers to questions regarding hosting renewal, domain integration, SSL, and revisions.
- [Contact Desk](https://www.ryxer.site/contact): Instant WhatsApp chat and email consultation.
